candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Dem report say e get ear problem. E no get cough or any wahala to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get fever. Dem no talk say e dey convulse now. Dem no talk say e don ever get convulsion before. E no dey weak or unconscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. E no dey complain of ear pain. Dem no see any ear discharge. Dem no see pus dey come out from ear. Dem no see any swelling wey dey pain behind ear.
